chains.name: McDonald's
chains.src: mcdonalds.co.za item nutrition, every size McDonald's lists (20 Nov 2026). McDonald's South Africa publishes Calories; kilojoules are worked out. Allergens are McDonald's own list for each item. Items whose energy is more than a third away from their macros are left out

chains.name: Nando's
chains.src: Nando's South Africa online menu, Allergens & Nutritional Info (20 Nov 2026). Nando's lists each item per 100 g with its serving weight; a serve is worked out from the two. Items with no serving weight are left out

chains.name: Wimpy
chains.src: Wimpy South Africa classic menu nutrition and allergens (20 Nov 2026), each item as Wimpy lists it. Figures Wimpy shows under more than one item are left out. Nut means peanuts or tree nuts
